event: Outdoor Shakespeare in Rowayton was the brainchild of Megan Crowley McAllister. She recruited Ezra Barnes and six others to form a Board and raise funds for the first production.
Rowayton's 6th Taxing District gave permission for the first production in Pinkney Park. The inaugural show was Much Ado About Nothing — an estimated 6,000 audience members attended.
Season extended to 16 performances. Audiences averaged 9,000 per year as community support grew.
Apprentice Company launched alongside expanded education programs — nearly 14,000 attended A Midsummer Night's Dream under Artistic Director Joanna Settle.
Returned to Pinkney Park for our 25th season with A Midsummer Night's Dream, then As You Like It in 2023.
30th season — Much Ado About Nothing at Pinkney Park, June 10–28. Gala October 16 at The House Up on the Hill, Norwalk.
